Four checks before you act

Pause

Scammers use urgency and secrecy. Take a moment before you act.

Use an official route

Open the official site or app yourself. Call published numbers, not the ones in the message.

Keep codes and payment details private

A security code can authorise an action. Treat it like a password.

Stop before sending money

Check bank transfer and crypto payments especially carefully.
